_note: Monochrome is Collective Edge's DEFAULT, not a law. A black CE block (the Collective) against a skewed Edge wedge, on a grey ramp that carries CE's own documents, decks, chrome and body copy. The real rule: every hue on a CE surface has a job you can name (ownership, state, meaning, or data), and nothing is colored for decoration. Color is expected in four places. (1) The Edge wedge may be rendered in CE gold #FFD630, preferred wherever the mark has to read small (favicons, tabs, avatars) and on co-brand surfaces. (2) On a partner-led co-brand surface the partner's palette leads and CE adds no hue. (3) On a CE-led product for a partner or their customer, the partner's accent is the one hue, used functionally (active nav, live state, one chart series). (4) Charts pick series colors for legibility and colorblind separation, not from this palette. White is the primary surface for documents; black is reserved for hero, section-divider and title surfaces. See SKILL.md section 2 for the co-brand rules.

black.role: Primary brand black; hero / divider surfaces

fog.role: The Edge wedge in its restrained grey treatment; the quiet half of the pair with gold

gold.role: The Edge wedge in its color treatment. The one hue CE owns, used on the wedge only, never on the block, the letters or as a UI accent

white.role: Primary brand white; primary document canvas

status._note: Used sparingly and functionally, healthcare context. Never decorative accents, and always paired with text or an arrow so meaning does not ride on color alone.

partners._note: 'Powered by Collective Edge' co-brand accents. THIS IS A CONVENIENCE MIRROR AND IT GOES STALE. Each partner's own brand kit is the source of truth for its colors and logos; pull from there. A partner's color may run the whole surface (partner-led mode A) or act as the single functional accent on a CE surface (CE-led mode B). It never colors the CE block or its letters; CE's own hue is brandCore.gold on the wedge only.
partners._textSafe: Bright partner brand colors usually fail 3:1 on white as text, small labels, or thin chart lines. Use the darkened step the partner's own kit ships (Apex gold #f9ad16 -> #B77808). Never invent your own darkening.
